title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: Seconds before Earth is demolished to make way for a galactic freeway, Arthur Dent is plucked off the planet by his friend Ford Prefect, who has been posing as an out-of-work actor for the last fifteen years but is really a researcher for the revised edition of The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.

title: The Restaurant at the End of the Universe
author: Douglas Adams
description: Facing annihilation at the hands of the warlike Vogons, Arthur Dent is rescued by his friend Ford Prefect and whisked off on a journey through time and space that lands them at Milliways, the Restaurant at the End of the Universe.

title: Life, the Universe and Everything
author: Douglas Adams
description: In consequence of a number of stunning catastrophes, Arthur Dent is surprised to find himself living in a hideously miserable cave on prehistoric Earth.

title: So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish
author: Douglas Adams
description: Arthur Dent returns to a seemingly unspoiled Earth and finds a girl sitting in a café who is convinced she is mad because the world is clearly full of strange things.

title: Mostly Harmless
author: Douglas Adams
description: Arthur Dent's accidental association with that wholly remarkable book, The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, has not been entirely without incident.

author: George Orwell
description: A startling and haunting novel about a totalitarian government that has total surveillance over its citizens. Winston Smith rewrites history for the Ministry of Truth, but his private life is one of rebellion and love.

title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
description: A farm is taken over by its overworked, mistreated animals. With flaming idealism and stirring slogans, they set out to create a paradise of progress, justice, and equality.

title: Homage to Catalonia
author: George Orwell
description: Orwell's personal account of his experiences and observations fighting for the Republican army in the Spanish Civil War.

title: Down and Out in Paris and London
author: George Orwell
description: A memoir of Orwell's time living among the desperately poor and destitute in Paris and London.

title: Burmese Days
author: George Orwell
description: Based on his experiences in the Indian Imperial Police, Orwell's first novel describes corruption and imperial bigotry in a society where the British are at the top.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: For twelve thousand years the Galactic Empire has ruled supreme. Now it is dying. But only Hari Seldon, creator of the revolutionary science of psychohistory, can see into the future—to a dark age of ignorance, barbarism, and warfare that will last thirty thousand years.

title: Foundation and Empire
author: Isaac Asimov
description: The Foundation has survived the greed and barbarism of its neighboring warrior-planets. Yet now it faces the Empire still the mightiest force in the Galaxy even in its death throes.

title: Second Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: After years of struggle, the Foundation lies in ruins—destroyed by the mutant mind power of the Mule. But it is rumored that there's a Second Foundation hidden somewhere at the end of the Galaxy.

title: I, Robot
author: Isaac Asimov
description: The three laws of Robotics: 1) A robot may not injure a human being or, through inaction, allow a human being to come to harm 2) A robot must obey orders given to it by human beings except where such orders would conflict with the First Law. 3) A robot must protect its own existence as long as such protection does not conflict with the First or Second Law.

title: The Gods Themselves
author: Isaac Asimov
description: In the twenty-second century Earth obtains limitless, free energy from a source science little understands: an exchange between Earth and a parallel universe.

title: Romeo and Juliet
author: William Shakespeare
description: Shakespeare's tragic tale of star-crossed lovers from feuding families in Verona.

title: Hamlet
author: William Shakespeare
description: The tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, who seeks revenge against his uncle for murdering his father.

title: Macbeth
author: William Shakespeare
description: A brave Scottish general named Macbeth receives a prophecy that one day he will become King of Scotland.

title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
author: William Shakespeare
description: A romantic comedy about the events surrounding the marriage of Theseus, the Duke of Athens, and Hippolyta.

title: The Tempest
author: William Shakespeare
description: Prospero, the rightful Duke of Milan, uses magic to restore his daughter Miranda to her rightful place.

title: Good Omens
author: Terry Pratchett
description: According to The Nice and Accurate Prophecies of Agnes Nutter, Witch, the world will end on a Saturday. Next Saturday, in fact. Just before dinner.

title: The Colour of Magic
author: Terry Pratchett
description: On a world supported on the back of a giant turtle, a gleeful, explosive, wickedly eccentric expedition begins.

title: Mort
author: Terry Pratchett
description: Death comes to us all. When he came to Mort, he offered him a job.

title: Guards! Guards!
author: Terry Pratchett
description: Long believed extinct, a superb specimen of draco nobilis has appeared in Discworld's greatest city.

title: Small Gods
author: Terry Pratchett
description: In the beginning was the Word. And the Word was: 'Hey, you!' For Brutha the novice is the Chosen One.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: The unforgettable novel of a childhood in a sleepy Southern town and the crisis of conscience that rocked it.

title: Go Set a Watchman
author: Harper Lee
description: Maycomb, Alabama. Twenty-six-year-old Jean Louise Finch returns home from New York City to visit her aging father, Atticus.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird (Screenplay)
author: Harper Lee
description: The screenplay adaptation of Harper Lee's beloved novel.

title: A Letter to Harper Lee
author: Harper Lee
description: A collection of letters and correspondence related to Harper Lee.

title: The Mockingbird Next Door
author: Harper Lee
description: Journalist Marja Mills spent years living next door to Harper Lee, experiencing a friendship that gave her unique insights.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the 'spice' melange.

title: Dune Messiah
author: Frank Herbert
description: Twelve years after his victory over House Harkonnen, Paul Atreides rules as emperor. But his enemies are still plotting.

title: Children of Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: The twins of Paul Muad'Dib Atreides become the prey of a ruthless conspiracy.

title: God Emperor of Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Millennia have passed on Arrakis, and the once-desert planet is green with life. Leto Atreides, the son of the world's savior, is now worshipped as the God Emperor.

title: Heretics of Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Leto Atreides, the God Emperor of Dune, is dead. In the fifteen hundred years since his passing, the Empire has fallen into ruin.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: The story of the mysteriously wealthy Jay Gatsby and his love for the beautiful Daisy Buchanan, set in Jazz Age Long Island.

title: Tender Is the Night
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: The story of Dick Diver and his wife Nicole, an American couple living in Europe in the 1920s.

title: This Side of Paradise
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: The debut novel that launched Fitzgerald's career, chronicling the life and loves of Amory Blaine, a handsome, spoiled youth.

title: The Beautiful and Damned
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: The story of Anthony Patch, a socialite and heir to a large fortune, and his wife Gloria as they live their lives in New York.

title: The Last Tycoon
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Fitzgerald's final novel, left incomplete at his death, about Hollywood film producer Monroe Stahr.
